Architecture

Medallion pipeline, in motion

Every record follows one governed route: ingested raw, refined into trusted tables, then modelled for decision-making.

Bronze · Ingest

Immutable landing zone. CSV, API and yfinance data is stored exactly as received, so every load is auditable.

Silver · Refine

Typed, de-duplicated and joined with dbt SQL. Quality checks gate each load before data moves forward.

Gold · Serve

Star Schema with business-ready KPIs, delivered to Power BI for fast, trusted reporting.
